html:
Ba Na, where the climate is 4 seasons in one day, is considered a paradise of Da Nang, and is also the place where many special festivals take place. Not only that, Ba Na is also a spiritual cultural space.

Linh Phong Bao Thap

Coming here, visitors will encounter floors with white stone statues of Buddha Shakyamuni, facing 4 directions East West South North, surrounded by statues of the Four Great Heavenly Kings.

The tower also has a bronze bell hanging on the 4 corners, symbolizing the sacred echo of a spiritual architectural work of the tower.

Linh Phong Thien Tu

This is a typical pagoda with its own architecture, the inside of the pagoda is made of ironwood, with a large campus, the pagoda has 18 statues of Buddha La Han, is an indispensable destination in the Ba Na tourism journey, visitors come here to pray for peace and happiness…

Tru Vu Tra Quan

A very suitable place to enjoy tea ceremony, and admire the floating sea of ​​clouds, the pagoda is built with its own design, the inside of the pagoda is decorated harmoniously, will bring visitors a quiet space, a feeling of peace and tranquility.

Mieu Ba

Is a spiritual place that many tourists visit, especially in early spring, many tourists come to pray for a healthy and peaceful new year, an indispensable destination in the spring travel journey to Da Nang.

Stele House

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ba Na, visitors should visit the stele house to feel a unique beauty, a beauty of a peaceful place, on the stele are carved romantic poems about the natural scenery of Ba Na.

Bell Tower

Built in Buddhist architecture, with a rather heavy gong placed right on top of Ba Na, when the temple bell rings on top of Ba Na, it is natural and relaxed, gentle as if blending into the quiet, empty world.

Linh Chua Linh Tu Temple

Located right at the intersection of heaven and earth, Linh Chua Linh Tu Temple is a place of worship to remember the merits of Ba Chua Thuong Ngan, a spiritual place in Da Nang, coming here visitors feel their souls are relaxed, all worries are dispelled, feeling serene.

Linh Ung Pagoda

In Da Nang, there are 3 pagodas with the same name in one city, and Linh Ung Ba Na Pagoda is located in a beautiful campus, a spiritual destination in Ba Na that many tourists come to worship and pray for health and peace.

So to offer incense and pray for peace and happiness, you should come to Da Nang – Ba Na once and visit those spiritual tourist destinations to pray for peace and happiness for your family and loved ones.
